title: Miss Portinari
html_source: Beatrice Portinari (Dante’s love interest) was married to Simon de Bardi, forming equal sides in a love triangle.

anchor.prefix:
so, Mr Bloom dittoed. 

 — Then, Stephen said, staring and rambling on to himself or some unknown listener somewhere, we have the impetuosity of Dante and the isosceles triangle,
anchor.suffix:
, he fell in love with and Leonardo and san Tommaso Mastino.
